items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And he got me in the band because I had a tone... And that's how that started.

ctx.x: suit made. I always wanted a pin stripe suit and I had that thing made and this fellow, he staid in the hotel, he had his tailor shop upstairs. He made the suit a little too small but I loved it anyway and somebody stole it. I'll tell you I was really sick about that. Brown pin stripe, yeah me.

But that's where Benny Harris heard me, you know, when Earl Hines came to town and he came in the club and he immediately told Budd Johnson and Scoops Carey and that's how I was hired. Benny Harris, the trumpet player. Yeah. He passed on. But he was playin' like Dizzy then. You know he was...he really had the feeling of Dizzy and everybody was crazy about him in the band. In fact, everybody was crazy about Little Benny; we called him "Little Benny". And he got me in the band because I had a tone. I wasn't a great…
Was he just passing through town then?
